subject: The 2-minute meeting hack 90% of users skip
preview_text: I wasn't going to share this, but it saves me 18 minutes every single meeting. The secret is in one tap.
body_paragraphs: I used to leave every meeting with 3 pages of frantic scribbles and zero clarity. Then I timed myself: 20 minutes. That's how long it took me to turn my chicken scratch into something I could actually use. The worst part? I was still missing things.

Here's what I discovered: The magic isn't in taking perfect notes. It's in letting the AI do the heavy lifting while you focus on what matters. You can capture everything, organize it instantly, and have a shareable summary ready before the next person even stands up. What used to be a 20-minute chore now takes me 120 seconds flat.

The trick is the 'Quick Capture' mode. Don't just use it for full transcriptions. Tap it at the START of any meeting. Let it run in the background. While you listen and engage, it's grabbing every word, every decision, every action item. When the meeting ends, your summary is already waiting. No typing. No organizing. Just results.

Open the app right now and tap the red microphone button. Start your next call with it running. You'll never go back. P.S. The real power move? Sharing the AI summary with your team while you're still on the call. It makes you look like a wizard.
